post.text: Everyone filming… then the giant ship rolls completely over https://t.co/KtHejDbdMc
post.author_description: Posting trending and viral videos around the world. Stay in the loop with what's buzzing! DM for credit or removal

description.description: A sequence of three frames showing a large container ship capsizing in rough seas while people on a nearby boat record the event. In the first frame, the ship is tilted heavily to its side, showing its red hull and stacked containers. In the second frame, the ship capsizes further, creating a massive splash and white mist as it hits the water. In the third frame, the ship has completely disappeared below the surface or into the mist, leaving only the witnesses in their yellow and black jackets visible on their vessel.

tweetMedia.transcription: Look at that list. I got two going. The containers are sliding. Holy! It's rolling, it's rolling right under! Look at that hole. Upside down! Oh my god, it's going under.
